name: Moe's Shell

nadir.desc: The property sits on a corner lot along 5th St and shares the lot with another business|A fuel canopy with pumps stands near 5th St beside a single-story flat-roof store building|A separate single-story building with a metal roof and light walls sits along the cross street at the opposite end of the lot|Paved concrete surrounds the canopy and store|A large open dirt and gravel lot fills the remainder of the parcel behind the buildings, with a utility pole near its center|Sidewalks run along the street frontages|No fencing is visible around the lot.

alpha.desc: The front of the site faces 5th St, a multi-lane road, with the fuel canopy and a pole sign at the corner|The canopy carries Marathon branding|The flat-roof store building sits behind the canopy, and paved concrete connects the pumps to the street|The open dirt and gravel lot extends to one side of the paved area|A signalized intersection sits at the corner of the lot.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows the large open dirt and gravel lot, with the metal-roof building, the store building and the fuel canopy beyond it|A utility pole stands near the center of the lot|A small planted strip with shrubs runs along the edge of the lot at the back street|The lot appears open to the adjacent streets with no curb or fence along much of its edge.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property shows the metal-roof building at the street corner, with windows facing the cross street|A paved area sits between the metal-roof building and the store building|An access point allows entry to the back of the lot, mirroring the one at the front of the lot|The open dirt and gravel lot extends behind the buildings to the back street, with a planted strip of shrubs along its outer edge|The fuel canopy and 5th St are visible beyond the store building.

delta.desc: The right side of the property faces the cross street, with the metal-roof building, the store building and the fuel canopy in a row along the street|Signs are mounted on the front wall of the metal-roof building, indicating an upholstery business|A paved area sits between the two buildings|Crosswalks are marked at both corners of this side of the block|The open dirt and gravel lot is visible behind the buildings.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from 5th St and the cross street onto the paved area around the fuel canopy, and the open dirt and gravel lot appears accessible from the adjacent streets along much of its edge. The site is a fuel station and store on a corner lot at a signalized intersection. The large open dirt and gravel lot would allow for staging and maneuvering on site. No fences or gates are visible from the imagery. Exact driveway locations and any entry-only or exit-only lanes cannot be confirmed from the imagery.
clarifications: Which door is the primary public entrance to the store, and is there a rear or service door?
